    AI Overview
    Valero Energy Corporation is
    a San Antonio-based Fortune 500 company and the world's largest independent petroleum refiner. It operates 15 refineries and 12 ethanol plants, producing transportation fuels like gasoline and diesel, while also leading in renewable diesel production. The company is heavily invested in low-carbon energy solutions. 
    Key Aspects of Valero: 
    • Refining Segment: Operates 15 refineries across the U.S., Canada, and the U.K. with a total throughput capacity of about 3.2 million barrels per day.
    • Renewable Energy: The company is a top producer of renewable diesel via its Diamond Green Diesel joint venture and operates 12 ethanol plants, making it a major player in low-carbon fuels
      .
    • Products: Manufactures gasoline (including TOP TIER™), diesel, jet fuel, and special products like asphalt, propane, and solvents.
    • Company Info: Headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, with nearly 10,000 employees.
    • Events: Title sponsor of the Valero Texas Open, a PGA Tour event. 
    Valero’s business focuses on conventional refining while expanding into renewable diesel, aiming for a mix of traditional and sustainable energy production.
